entries.name: gapFill
entries.title: Gap fill
entries.doc: Of the sessions that opened with a gap, how often price traded back to the prior session's close. Roll days are excluded by construction: a gap across a futures roll is a roll, not a gap.
examples: gapFill WHERE gapPct BETWEEN 0.2% AND 0.6% AND dayOfWeek = Tue
gapFill WHERE fvgPresent(open, below) AND NOT eventDay('FOMC')
entries.valueDoc: Minutes from the open to the fill, among filled sessions.

entries.name: gapHold
entries.title: Gap holds (gap-and-go)
entries.doc: Of the sessions that opened with a gap, how often the gap NEVER filled and the session closed beyond its open in the gap's direction: the gap-and-go continuation, measured directly instead of as the complement of the fill rate.

entries.name: gapReversal
entries.title: Reversal after gap fill
entries.doc: Of the sessions that filled their opening gap, how often the session then closed beyond the prior close against the gap's direction (fill-and-reverse).

entries.name: closeGreen
entries.title: Session closes green
entries.doc: How often the session closed above its open, under whatever conditions you compose.
entries.valueDoc: Open→close return distribution across eligible sessions.

entries.name: nextCloseGreen
entries.title: Next session closes green
entries.doc: How often the NEXT session closed green given today's conditions: the day-after family of questions as one outcome.

entries.name: orbBreak
entries.title: Opening range break
entries.doc: Of the sessions with a formed opening range, how often the range broke in the given direction.
entries.valueDoc: Minutes from the open to the first break, among breaking sessions.

entries.name: gapUp
entries.title: Gapped up
entries.doc: The session opened above the prior session's close.

entries.name: gapDown
entries.title: Gapped down
entries.doc: The session opened below the prior session's close.

entries.name: noGap
entries.title: No gap
entries.doc: The session opened exactly at the prior session's close (or gap data is unavailable).

entries.name: orbBroke
entries.title: Opening range broke
entries.doc: The session broke its opening range (first n minutes) in the given direction after the range formed.

entries.name: orbFalseBroke
entries.title: Opening range false break (condition)
entries.doc: The first opening-range break failed: price closed back inside the range (or beyond the opposite side). Condition form of the orbFalseBreak outcome.

entries.name: orbBrokeBoth
entries.title: Opening range broke both sides
entries.doc: The session traded beyond both extremes of its opening range.

entries.name: dayOfWeek
entries.title: Day of week
entries.doc: Weekday of the session's trade date (Mon–Sun). The classic seasonality cut: any query can be grouped or filtered by it.

entries.name: month
entries.title: Month
entries.doc: Calendar month of the trade date (1–12), for monthly seasonality cuts.

entries.name: year
entries.title: Year
entries.doc: Calendar year of the trade date. Grouping by year is the manual stability check.

entries.name: rangePct
entries.title: Session range %
entries.doc: Session high-to-low range as a percent of the session's open.

entries.name: retOcPct
entries.title: Open→close return %
entries.doc: Session return from open to close, in percent (signed).

entries.name: green
entries.title: Green session
entries.doc: True when the session closed above its open.

_note: first six of each kind, from edgestats 0.1.0
